<title level="1" right="Spell 1" pfs="Standard">
[Breathe Fire](/Spells.aspx?ID=1457)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 319

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

**Deities**
[Angradd](/Deities.aspx?ID=84), [Chohar](/Deities.aspx?ID=215), [Lady Nanbyo](/Deities.aspx?ID=311), [Moloch](/Deities.aspx?ID=70), [Nurgal](/Deities.aspx?ID=78), [Ra](/Deities.aspx?ID=57), [Rovagug](/Deities.aspx?ID=291), [Sarenrae](/Deities.aspx?ID=292), [Szuriel](/Deities.aspx?ID=136), [Walkena](/Deities.aspx?ID=159), [Ymeri](/Deities.aspx?ID=108)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Area** 15-foot cone

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Defense**
[basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex

</row>

</column>

---

A gout of flame sprays from your mouth. You deal 2d6 fire damage to creatures in the area with a basic Reflex save.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.
